metadata_readback.title: feat(QPBT/Combining): preserve point consistency auxiliaries
metadata_readback.body:
### Motivation
- Preserve the three unique public supplied-witness contracts and original
  issue #515 evidence from PR #534. The source-labelled `lem:qld-xz-lines`
  obligations and the recorded sum/product error qualification remain open.

### Description
- Preserve two exact point-consistency defect bounds and exact
  discarded-mass restoration in two auxiliary modules, with imports and
  matching auxiliary blueprint entries.
- Retain qualified historical audit and event archives, including the
  failed fixture checks and earlier effort. The original public PR and
  issue remain available for a separate disposition after integration.
- Refresh the existing preservation commit `d831db9b` by an ordinary merge
  to `5ae31941`. Both added Lean module blobs are unchanged. This change
  does not complete the source line-consistency theorem.

### Testing
- The original preservation packet passed focused Lean, targeted module
  builds, root import, three fresh standard-only axiom closures, blueprint
  render/sync/citations/checkdecls and normal commit hooks. Historical
  excerpts were checked byte for byte; evidence is retained in the
  preservation receipt and manifest.
- MAIN verified the clean refreshed head, ordered merge parents, unchanged
  added Lean modules and freshness before publication. Normal checked push
  and the public-head readback passed.
- Exact-head CI passed all nine contexts in389 seconds on `5ae31941`.
  The full build, blueprint render/sync, paper-gap, file-length,
  proof-debt and proof-evasion gates ran; LDT statement-origin was skipped
  by changed-path rules. The rooted blueprint axiom audit passed1662
  declarations with zero failures and three existing statement-level
  warnings. No proof-level completeness claim depends on `sorryAx`.
- Fresh independent review remains pending.

---
Addresses #515
